reason: Visible issues: (1) Policy requires one tool call at a time; the last assistant turn made multiple simultaneous calls (transfer + two flight searches), and now again issues a lone calculate, violating the sequential rule. (2) The assistant made flight search calls without obtaining explicit user confirmation to run tools, though the user did ask to check pricing. (3) The proposed calculation (business sum ×2 − economy sum ×2) reflects the price difference for the upgrade for 2 passengers, but policy does not state the upgrade price formula beyond 'pay the difference,' and the reservation's original payment_history is a lump 490, so the computed difference may not match the API's expectation. The cancellation of IFOYYZ was correctly denied per policy, and NQNU5R transfer is justified. Overall the user's core requests (cancel IFOYYZ, upgrade M20IZO) are partly unfulfillable or still incomplete, so nontrivial failure risk remains.
